_meta.file: Design System | UI kit | +6000 Components (Community), key 313oReHdGPh8T1QRLUdbPv
_meta.grading: by Figma PAGE (component family). Third real file, a small atomic UI kit: 24 component sets, ~1.4k non-icon standalone components. Icons page (6000) is excluded.
_meta.labels: Written by Claude from page names, variant properties and text in the saved file JSON (not from renders). Needs are phrased by what a product team would ask for, not by the page names. Treat as author-labelled, not independent.

cases.need: A call-to-action button with primary, secondary and outline styles in small, medium and large sizes, with hover, pressed and disabled states
A round button that contains only an icon
Small colored status labels such as success, warning, danger and info
A badge showing a task's progress: not started, in progress, done or delayed
A text field with a label, placeholder, helper text and error and success validation states
An input where the user types and adds multiple tags or chips
A large prominent input field, for a search or hero form
An on/off toggle switch for a setting
A multi-line text box for a message or comment
A dropdown to choose one option from a list that opens on click
A 1 to 5 star rating control, or a hearts variant
A checkbox for selecting options in a form
A vertical sidebar menu of items with icons, active and hover states
A top navigation bar with logo and links, in several colors, aligned left, center or right
A product card with a picture, name, category and price
A log-in card with email and password fields
A card with an email field and a message box to send an invitation
A landing-page hero section with a headline, short text and a button
A mobile bottom tab bar for switching between app sections
A mobile status bar and home indicator for phone screen mockups
A brand logo mark to place in a header
Decorative illustrations or background patterns for empty states and marketing pages
A sortable, paginated data table with row selection
A calendar date picker with range selection
A modal dialog with a confirm and cancel footer
A horizontal tabs component for switching content panels
A line chart with tooltips and a legend
A toast notification that auto-dismisses
A drag-and-drop file upload area with progress
